headline: Late-night host Seth Meyers mocked President Trump's push to end the clock change and joked that he posts "AI slop" at 4am.
score_reason: Pool score 2 lowered by 1: the broadcast was on 5 Oct and the AI link is a single joke.
importance_line: Mainly entertainment; the clock-change bill is a real political issue, but the AI reference is only a quip, and the claim about posting is a joke, not a finding.
summary: The Irish Star reports that on his 5 Oct 2026 show Seth Meyers ridiculed Donald Trump's claims that people are late because of clock changes, saying phones and cars now update the time automatically, and joked that Trump's real problem is being awake at 4am posting AI-generated junk online. The report adds that the House passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent 308-117 in July and that it remains stalled in the Senate.
notes: Pool item came from Soap Central (blocked); read the Irish Star report of the same broadcast and credited it. Broadcast date 5 Oct, before 6 Oct, so score lowered and the summary gives the date.
